title: Future Me Called And Said NOTHING ☎️
description:
On your thirtieth birthday, your phone rings once, and it's you, calling from later with advice. My mom's told her to buy a better umbrella. My uncle's told him to sell the boat.

Mine rang in Dad's garage at noon. For nine minutes, all I heard was breathing.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment JOKE if your dad has a worst one too.
